item.title: News Flow — 2026-09-10
item.description: Bugünün öne çıkan haberleri: Trump administration proposes waiving grace period for H-1B holders after job loss; Sept. 11 ranks among the most historic events in many Americans’ lifetimes, polling shows; Yemen's Houthis reportedly seize strategic Red Sea port of Mokha; Zelenskyy visits Canada to seek further military support for Ukraine; US wholesale prices rise in latest sign of stubborn inflation as oil prices continue to climb; Pilot warned Amazon cargo plane going too fast before deadly crash, data shows
